_about: The Artifact-master's artefact cooldown bonus (the owner, 2026-11-05): modification 1310, -20 % on parameters/artefact_cooldown_modifier (player modifier 38: the active's end 0x313530 starts the cooldown at cooldown_sec x max(0, 1 + S)), shown as card property 173 the way 1134 shows the search time on 108. Type 41, a type of its own (never rolled: drop weight 0). The booster's config gets the key at 0, as every booster carries its bonuses' keys: the item cook skips a modifier whose key the config lacks. boosters.tsv makes 1310 the booster's built-in, modifications.tsv holds its row. docs/notes/artefacts.md.
